description: Assign Polyperc 1 to channel 1 and Doubledecker to channel 2. Enter MIDI 48 and 55 for the bass, then MIDI 60 and 62 for the chord roots. Set Chd1 to 3rd and Chd2 to 5th on channel 2. Use velocity 48 for the bass and 32 for the chords. Play the four-bar loop to hear the bass and chords together.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
title: A bass with room above it
